Name: The Long Road to Empire
Description: A five-part single-player campaign assembled from the project's historical scenario maps. Rebuild in Laconia, fight through Delphi, survive the road east, face Rome in Macedonia, and force your way through the Persian Gates.

awakening.Name: I — The Spartan Valley
awakening.Description: Macedonian pressure has reached Laconia. Rebuild your economy, restore your army, and hold the valley before the invaders can overwhelm you.

delphi.Name: II — The Road to Delphi
delphi.Description: The fighting spreads into central Greece. Secure the approaches to Delphi and defeat the invading force.

heartland.Name: III — The Heartland of Arcadia
heartland.Description: The campaign moves into Arcadia. Expand through difficult terrain, protect your settlements, and destroy the opposing army.

macedonia.Name: IV — The Third Macedonian War
macedonia.Description: Rome has entered Macedonia. Command through the decisive confrontation and break the enemy's hold over the region.

finale.Name: V — The Persian Gates
finale.Description: The final march leads east. Force the mountain pass, defeat the defenders, and open the road beyond the Gates.
